The Government of India has approved the *Kanpur–Kabrai 4-Lane Access-Controlled Greenfield Highway* with an estimated cost of ₹7,145.14 Crore. This ambitious infrastructure project is expected to strengthen connectivity between *Kanpur, Hamirpur & Mahoba (Kabrai)* while supporting industrial growth & improving regional road infrastructure in Uttar Pradesh.
In this video, we explore the complete details of the project, including:
• Complete Route Map
• Districts & Villages Covered
• Highway Features
• Project Cost
• BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) Model
• Land Acquisition Details
